name: Counter-Strike 2

benchmark.where_to_test: Play → Practice → Workshop map "CS2 FPS Benchmark" (or Dust II offline with bots). When the map has loaded, press F9 and let the flythrough run.

tips: CS2 is often limited by your processor, so some settings make no difference. FrameForge finds out which ones do on your PC.
Online matches are never touched. Testing happens in an offline map.

settings.label: Shadows
settings.help: How sharp and detailed shadows are. In CS2 shadows can reveal enemies, so very low isn't always best.

settings.label: Moving shadows
settings.help: Shadows from players and objects that move.

settings.label: Texture detail
settings.help: Sharpness of surfaces. Mostly uses graphics memory, not speed.

settings.label: Texture sharpness at a distance
settings.help: Keeps floors and walls crisp when seen at an angle.

settings.label: Effects (smoke, sparks)
settings.help: Detail of explosions, smoke and sparks.

settings.label: Edge smoothing
settings.help: Removes jagged edges. Higher costs more speed.

settings.label: Brightness range
settings.help: Bright light and dark areas look more natural.

settings.label: Render scaling (FSR)
settings.help: Draws the game smaller and sharpens it back up. Faster but a little softer.
